About Cuba Fresh

Cuba Fresh is a trusted and premium name in the meat and seafood retail industry, proudly serving the communities of West Kochi. We are dedicated to taking the hassle out of your cooking by delivering 100% fresh, toxic-free, and high-quality products right from nature to your kitchen. Our extensive seafood selection features fresh catches from the sea, backwaters, and rivers, including a daily variety of fish, crab, squid, prawns, and clam meat. Our fish comes 100% scaled, gutted, and thoroughly cleaned, while our premium prawns are delivered completely deshelled and deveined with heads and tails removed.

In our poultry and red meat sections, absolute freshness and customer preference are our highest priorities. We supply premium Country Chicken (Local), Broiler Chicken, Kuttanadan Duck, Country Broiler Duck, and Quail (Kada). We strictly never sell frozen or refrigerated products; everything is processed live and fresh on demand. Customers can choose their poultry dressed or undressed, fully cleaned, and customized exactly to their liking. We also offer premium quality local beef, buffalo, veal, and tender mutton handled with strict hygienic standards.

Beyond daily household needs, Cuba Fresh is a specialized partner for the food service sector and special occasions. We provide specialized chicken cuts with skin for popular Arabic dishes like Al Faham, Shawaya, and Kuzhimandhi. We also specialize in bulk wholesale supply, offering high-quality meat and seafood at competitive wholesale rates for weddings, parties, hotels, and catering services. All our premium products come with free cutting and cleaning, delivered straight to your doorstep, with Free Home Delivery across Thoppumpady, Mattancherry, Fort Kochi, and nearby areas.
